correctness.rationale: The symmetric Frobenius gradient of off-diagonal coordinates is (e_i e_j^T+e_j e_i^T)/2. Projection onto H=H^T, H1=0, tr H=0 via PAP-tr(PAP)P/(n-1) has squared diagonal/off-diagonal norms (n-1)(n-2)/n^2 and (n-2)(n^2-n+2)/(2n^2(n-1)). Summing coordinate clearances gives the exact min of t/(nd_n) and (n-t)/(n(n-1)o_n), attained by the permutation-invariant matrix. Equality conditions imply Y>=0 hollow symmetric row-stochastic for t<tau_n, and a unique uniform point for t>=tau_n. The unsigned complete-graph incidence rank n gives incenter dimension n(n-3)/2, and the classical half-integral extremal supports are disjoint edges and odd cycles; counts f4=3,f5=22,f6=25 follow. Independent projected-gradient matrix arithmetic at n=4,5,8,12 exactly matches formulas.
